newsitem.title: UK: BADMINTON-OLYMPIC CHAMPIONS BEATEN IN ALL-ENGLAND DOUBLES.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-OLYMPIC CHAMPIONS BEATEN IN ALL-ENGLAND DOUBLES.

text.p: The world's most successful badminton doubles partnership suffered a surprise exit at the All England championships late on Thursday.

Indonesians Rexy Mainaky and Ricky Subagja, the world, Olympic and Grand Prix finals champions, lost their quarter-final in straight games to delighted Danes Jon Holst-Christensen and Michael Sogaard.
Mainaky and Subagja were seeking their third All England title in succession but were seeded only joint third after a slight dip in form since the Atlanta Games.
But their defeat by the unseeded Danish pair was still unexpected.
Mainaky summed up: "We tried to attack and that didn't work, so we tried to defend and that didn't work either."
Subagja said: "We were quite surprised at the Danes. They don't normally play quite so well as that."
Indonesia can look for compensation later on Friday in the men's singles semifinals where another world champion, Heryanto Arbi, faces joint third seed Sun Jun of China.
But they have no representative in the women's singles following the defeat in Thursday's quarter-finals of four-times All England winner Susi Susanti.
